paper_id: LONGCODEU_ Benchmarking Long-Context Language Models on Long Code Understanding
title: LONGCODEU: Benchmarking Long-Context Language Models on Long Code Understanding
motivation: 现有基准测试无法有效评估LCLMs的真实长代码理解能力
problem_framing: 从四个维度(代码单元感知/单元内理解/单元间关系理解/文档理解)系统评测LCLMs
key_insight: 跨代码单元关系理解是LCLMs最具挑战性的能力,性能在32K后急剧下降
method_signature: 构建包含8任务~500例/0-128K token的LONGCODEU基准
evaluation_criteria: 使用EM/LCS/CodeBLEU/BLEU等检索指标进行自动评测
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: LCLMs性能在32K后急剧下降,远未达到声称的128K-1M上下文窗口
evidence_for_taste: only focusing on needle function search
ignoring context dependency in real-world source code
does not decouple the long code understanding ability
falls far short of their claimed context windows
thinking_moves: 把长代码理解问题分解为四个递进维度
从合成代码转向真实仓库依赖关系
用检索指标而非下游任务性能来独立测量理解能力
通过长度分桶揭示性能衰减规律
